thread:
Maya (CS): Heads up — prepping an account health readout for OrionCorp execs next Wed. Need slide owners + two top risks: onboarding cadence and a potential renewal gap. Quick sync 2pm today?
Ravi (CS): I can own the onboarding slide. Current status: 70% active seats, 3 outstanding integrations (SFTP, SCIM, webhooks). ETA for SFTP fix: Tue EOD.
Jo (CSM): I'll take renewal risk + timeline. FYI finance flagged a likely 20% discount ask if we hit <30d to renewal. Need options to present.
Sam (PM): I'll do the product roadmap slide — will call out a 4‑week quick-win plus the longer backlog. Propose risk bins: green <5% churn signal, amber 5–15%, red >15%.
Diego (Enablement): Collected feedback from last enablement cohort — top asks: clearer role-based templates and a step-by-step SFTP onboarding doc. I put notes in the doc: https://go.redwood/example (will paste top quotes).
Maya (CS): Action items capture:
- Ravi: onboarding slide + runbook snippet + one demo clip (if allowed)
- Jo: renewal slide + executive ask options + 90/60/30 touch plan
- Sam: roadmap slide + timeline + dependencies
- Diego: paste top-5 feedback quotes and two enablement asks
I'll stitch slides and own the narrative. Rehearsal Fri 10am. @eng-infra-bot FYI on demo gating.
Ravi (CS): Quick Q — want to include a live demo of the onboarding flow. Eng infra needs to greenlight data access. @eng-infra-bot any objections?
eng-infra-bot: Demo clearance: approved if demo uses sanitized dataset and scrubbed logs. Please include perf knobs (p95 latency, token cost delta).
Sam (PM): Noted — I'll include perf metrics. Do we want a split by Hosted vs Dedicated for cost compars?
Jo (CSM): Yes split is helpful. Also adding the renewal asks slide: concierge onboarding package + 6-week success SLA as options. Will draft 2 pricing scenarios (conservative / aggressive).
Maya (CS): Two exec talking points to prep: 1) adoption trajectory (what moved in last 30 days), 2) concrete mitigation plan for churn (ops + product commitments). Also need a single slide titled "Ask from Execs" — suggestions?
Diego (Enablement): Suggested asks: approve headcount for one Solutions Eng (6 months) + greenlight partner funding for SFTP integration. I'll capture one-liners and sample quotes.
Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll update the master deck after lunch and ping for review by 5pm. Rehearsal invite Fri 10am — bring 3 talking bullets each. :eyes:
rehearsal-bot: Calendar invite sent to participants for Fri 10:00 — agenda: 1) run-through slides 2) prep exec Q&A 3) finalize asks.
Maya (CS): Small follow-up — Ravi, can you paste the SFTP test snippet into the doc so infra can sanity-check? Anyone else with slide updates tag me in the doc.
Ravi (CS): Yep — pasted SFTP snippet and quick gif. Will add a one‑liner about mitigation steps if rollout lags.
Jo (CSM): I'll queue the pricing scenarios into slide 10 and add the 90/60/30 cadence.
Sam (PM): Roadmap slide updated with dates and owners. Added a short note on dependencies for the quick-win.
Diego (Enablement): Pasted top-5 quotes and proposed two role templates.
Maya (CS): Thanks team — final ask: once slides are in, add a 1‑sentence "why this matters" under each slide for exec consumption. I'll compile and send to execs after dry run.
Sam (PM): Got it.
Ravi (CS): Will do.
Jo (CSM): On it. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Great — see you at 2pm sync and Fri rehearsal.
